title: Multimodal Cultural Safety: Evaluation Framework and Alignment Strategies
reasoning: The paper introduces the CROSS benchmark, which explicitly evaluates models on dimensions of cultural safety including 'Religious Sanctity', 'Sacred Time & Space', and 'Ritual Participation Norms'. It features specific test cases related to Shinto rituals, Islamic law (e.g., prohibitions on gambling and alcohol), and sacred spiritual traditions like Thai Sak Yant tattoos.
